publisher: City of Harrison, Ohio (personal ArcGIS Online copy by JimLeslie; parcel layer carrying zoning)
notes: Unofficial copy on ArcGIS Online by an individual (JimLeslie), not the City of Harrison. Parcel-level layer (owner and tax fields) whose Zoning attribute carries each parcel districts code (R-1, R-4, M-1, DRD, JEDD, OA, ODOT and others); used as last resort because the city publishes its zoning map only as a scanned PDF and a GIS link that could not be reached. No zone name or link field. Blank Zoning values are parcels with no district.
